reason: 一次資料の要旨・本文が示す対象はLLM推論システムの計算量、メモリ、レイテンシ、スループット、KV cache、量子化、offload、servingの改善と技術的につながらない。The paper improves multihop reasoning through attribution-oriented training/data. Its evaluation is reasoning quality, not memory/offload or inference performance; the linked training-memory systems relation is unsupported.
title: Making Long-Context Language Models Better Multi-Hop Reasoners
